description: This file defines a web scraper class 'FlavorsByLinbie' for extracting recipe data from flavorsbylinbie.com, including methods for retrieving author, title, category, total time, ingredients, instructions, description, and yields.

classes.name: FlavorsByLinbie
classes.description: A scraper class for flavorsbylinbie.com recipes, extending AbstractScraper and implementing methods to extract recipe details.

methods.name: author
methods.description: Extracts the recipe author, first from schema, then from HTML, or defaults to site name.

methods.name: title
methods.description: Retrieves the recipe title from the page title or H1 heading.

methods.name: category
methods.description: Gets the recipe category from schema or meta tag.

methods.name: total_time
methods.description: Calculates total time from headings or paragraph content.

methods.name: _extract_time_from_servings_section
methods.description: Helper to extract prep or cook time from servings section.

methods.name: yields
methods.description: Determines recipe yields from paragraph or headings.

methods.name: _get_servings_time_paragraph
methods.description: Retrieves paragraph containing servings and time info.

methods.name: _slice_field
methods.description: Slices and cleans a specific field from a paragraph based on label.

methods.name: _normalize_time_phrase
methods.description: Normalizes time phrases to a standard format.

methods.name: _extract_time_from_paragraph
methods.description: Extracts minutes from a paragraph based on label.

methods.name: ingredients
methods.description: Extracts list of ingredients from 'What You'll Need' section.

methods.name: description
methods.description: Extracts a brief description of the recipe.
